basic.description:
{Basic Triune Order}

Increases the damage bonus of ascendant troops to 30%.
The hero gets +1 Attack.

 {#F800F8|Synergies} 
 {#002366|Sickle Titans}: Sickle Titans get +2 Attack and Defense.
 {#D7D7D7|Tactics}: ascendant troops get a further +1 Speed.
 {#D7D7D7|Leadership}: ascendant troops get +1 Morale this round.
 {#D7D7D7|Divine Echo}: in a round when an Echo occurs, troops of the patron god's Aspect are ascendant.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Triune Order}

Increases the damage bonus of ascendant troops to 45%.
The hero gets +2 Attack.
The Titan Cycle starts from the Aspect of the hero's patron god.

 {#F800F8|Synergies} 
 {#002366|Sickle Titans}: Sickle Titans get +2 Attack and Defense.
 {#D7D7D7|Tactics}: ascendant troops get a further +1 Speed.
 {#D7D7D7|Leadership}: ascendant troops get +1 Morale this round.
 {#D7D7D7|Divine Echo}: in a round when an Echo occurs, troops of the patron god's Aspect are ascendant.

expert.description:
{Expert Triune Order}

Increases the damage bonus of ascendant troops to 60%.
The hero gets +3 Attack.
The Titan Cycle starts from the Aspect of the hero's patron god.
Hero forms also count as ascendant in rounds when the patron god's Aspect is ascendant.

 {#F800F8|Synergies} 
 {#002366|Sickle Titans}: Sickle Titans get +2 Attack and Defense.
 {#D7D7D7|Tactics}: ascendant troops get a further +1 Speed.
 {#D7D7D7|Leadership}: ascendant troops get +1 Morale this round.
 {#D7D7D7|Divine Echo}: in a round when an Echo occurs, troops of the patron god's Aspect are ascendant.

basic.description:
{Basic Divine Echo}

After the hero casts an Atlantean god power, it has a 30% chance to echo:
the same power takes effect once more on a random target, at half strength and at no Spell Point cost.

 {#F800F8|Synergies} 
 {#002366|Moss Titans}: Moss Titans get +2 Attack and Defense.
 {#D7D7D7|Sorcery}: Echo chance +10%.
 {#D7D7D7|Luck}: all your troops get +1 Luck in a round when an Echo occurs.
 {#D7D7D7|Triune Order}: in a round when an Echo occurs, troops of the patron god's Aspect are ascendant.
